title: VTG February 1986 Playboy Complete With Centerfold Lips Portals Of Desire
descriptionText: The product is a vintage February 1986 issue of Playboy magazine, featuring the iconic centerfold lips and articles on topics such as modeling. Published by American Media Inc, this English-language publication offers a glimpse into the history and cultural norms of the time. Although not signed, this monthly magazine provides a unique window into the world of entertainment, lifestyle, and beauty from over three decades ago. A must-have for collectors and enthusiasts of vintage magazines.
